about_the_game:
In order to enjoy the content included in the DLC Subscription you will need to own the Hearts of Iron IV base game.


Hearts of Iron IV is Paradox Interactive’s grand strategy wargame. Command the mightiest war machines in history, rewriting the events of World War II as the fires of conflict swirl around you.

If you are missing some or all of the Hearts of Iron IV expansions or other additional content for the game, this subscription plan makes much of that available for you so you can experience the titanic struggle of 20th century ideologies to its fullest extent for a convenient monthly price.

With this subscription, you will have access to all expansion and country packs released to this point, as well as all art and music packs, but not the Community Content Packs - these must be purchased separately. The precise contents of subscription change with every new Hearts of Iron IV release. This subscription also does not include access to any pre-order bonuses that may have been offered or advertised.
